name: Hisui
source:
One of the Eight Guardians. 
He acts as the Byakko of Earth for his era's White Dragon Priestess. 
Family: Father and mother (estranged), younger brother (estranged)
Occupation: Pirate captain
Innate Element: Metal
Weapon(s): Dragon Star Spindle (rope with two circular weights at its ends; tied around his torso)
Hobbies: Flower viewing
Favorite Scent: Jijuu
Favorite Color: Silver
Favorite Flower(s): Golden lace (autumn) / Satsuma (winter)

[From [url=http://koei.wikia.com/wiki/Harukanaru_Toki_no_Naka_de_2]Koei Wiki[/url]]
